title: New-Realism Analyzer: a computational-ontology model for mapping competing realities in constitutional texts
description:
A Python package that reads a constitutional text and returns a structured breakdown in three strata — Record, Enunciation, Mediation — following Maurizio Ferraris’s New Realism: entities typed as physical, ideal or social, and each claim labelled with a hermeneutic operator (naturalised, revealed, other) together with the ground on which the clause makes a founding act rest.

The model named in the title is that three-strata analytical framework, not a trained model. The package distributes source code, schemas, prompts and a codebook; it calls external language models through an interchangeable back end and ships no weights. Every output is labelled emendable and carries a model hash and a date, so any reading can be traced back to the exact configuration that produced it.
